duplicate_method: SHA-256 over native decoded RGB pixels plus width/height; one representative retained per same-label pixel group. No cross-class pixel conflicts were found.
limitations: Decoded-pixel deduplication does not identify all perceptual near-duplicates or related views of the same leaf/plant.
The Healthy class contains only 26 decoded-pixel-unique images.
Published JMuBEN/JMuBEN2 count 58,555 differs by six from this archive's 58,549 files; the discrepancy is unresolved.
